hero.headline: Building a Global Supply Chain
hero.subheadline: We are seeking reliable partners to supply over $18M in compute and infrastructure hardware for our 1MW project.

sections.title: A Transparent and Fair Procurement Framework
sections.body: Our procurement philosophy is based on three principles: technical excellence, cost-efficiency, and logistical reliability. For the 1MW Phase, Kenya AI Compute is managing a multi-stage tender process for server hardware, networking equipment, and data center engineering systems. We encourage vendors from across the globe—especially those with a strong presence in the EMEA and Asian markets—to participate. Our evaluation criteria prioritize 'Total Cost of Ownership' (TCO), warranty terms, and the supplier's ability to provide regional support in Kenya. By registering through this portal, you will gain access to our detailed Request for Proposals (RFPs) and become part of our long-term supplier ecosystem as we scale toward our 3MW target. Additional context: the project follows a clear rollout roadmap that aligns low-cost energy, infrastructure reliability, and flexible deployment models. sections.title: Tender Categories
items: Compute: GPU servers (NVIDIA/AMD), CPU nodes, and specialized AI accelerators.
Storage: High-density NVMe arrays and object storage solutions.
Infrastructure: Modular containers, UPS units, and precision cooling systems.
Networking: Core/Leaf switches, fiber cabling, and security appliances.
Operations: Monitoring software, BMS integration, and on-site maintenance tools.
